subject: math
question:
如图 6.6 所示，设 $P(\dot{x}, y), Q(x, y)$ 具有连续的偏导数，且对以任意点 $(x_0, y_0)$ 为圆心，以任意正数 $r$ 为半径的上半圆 $L: x = x_0 + r\cos \theta$ ， $y = y_0 + r\sin \theta (0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \pi)$ ，恒有

$$
\int_ {L} P (x, y) \mathrm{d} x + Q (x, y) \mathrm{d} y = 0.
$$

图6.6
answer: 到 $P(x_0, y_0) = 0$ ，由 $(x_0, y_0)$ 的任意性，知 $P(x, y) = 0$ ，再由①式可得

steps.text:
$P(x,y) = 0$ ， $\frac{\partial Q(x,y)}{\partial x}\equiv 0.$

分析 要从积分值得到函数值，最常用的方法是用积分中值定理。而积分中值定理只有数量值函数的积分才具备。因此，可考虑用格林公式将曲线积分转化为二重积分。

证明 记上半圆周 $L$ 的直径为 $AB$ ，取 $AB + L$ 为逆时针方向；记 $D$ 为 $AB + L$ 所包围的区域。由于 $\int_{L} P(x, y) \mathrm{d}x + Q(x, y) \mathrm{d}y = 0$ ，则有

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\int_ {A B} P (x, y) \mathrm{d} x + Q (x, y) \mathrm{d} y = \oint_ {A B + L} P (x, y) \mathrm{d} x + Q (x, y) \mathrm{d} y} \\ & {\underline {{{{\underline {{{{\text {格林公式}}}}}}}}} \iint_ {D} \left(\frac {\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac {\partial P}{\partial y}\right) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \underline {{{{\underline {{{{\text {积分中值定理}}}}}}}}} \left(\frac {\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac {\partial P}{\partial y}\right) \Bigg | _ {M _ {1}} \iint_ {D} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y} \\ & {= \left(\frac {\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac {\partial P}{\partial y}\right) \Bigg | _ {M _ {1}} \cdot \frac {\pi r ^ {2}}{2} \quad (\text {其中} M _ {1} \in D \text {为某一点}).} \end{array}
$$

另一方面

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\int_ {A B} P (x, y) \mathrm{d} x + Q (x, y) \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {x _ {n} - r} ^ {x _ {0} + r} P (x, y _ {0}) \mathrm{d} x} \\ & {\stackrel {\text {积分中值定理}} {=} P (\xi , y _ {0}) \cdot 2 r \quad (x _ {0} - r <   \xi <   x _ {0} + r).} \end{array}
$$

于是有

$$
\left. \left(\frac {\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac {\partial P}{\partial y}\right) \right| _ {M _ {1}} \cdot \frac {\pi r ^ {2}}{2} = P (\xi , y _ {0}) \cdot 2 r, \text {即} \left(\frac {\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac {\partial P}{\partial y}\right) \Bigg | _ {M _ {1}} \cdot \frac {\pi r}{2} = 2 P (\xi , y _ {0}).\tag{①}
$$

令 $r \to 0$ ，两边取极限，得到 $P(x_0, y_0) = 0$ ，由 $(x_0, y_0)$ 的任意性，知 $P(x, y) = 0$ ，再由①式可得

$\left.\frac{\partial Q(x,y)}{\partial x}\right|_{M_1} = 0$ ，从而 $\lim_{r\to 0}\frac{\partial Q(x,y)}{\partial x}\Bigg|_{M_1} = 0$ ，即 $\left.\frac{\partial Q(x,y)}{\partial x}\right|_{(x_0,y_0)} = 0$

由 $(x_0, y_0)$ 的任意性知 $\frac{\partial Q(x, y)}{\partial x} \equiv 0$ .
